# readable.app

> readable.app is a gamified deep-focus reading platform that turns long-form books and EPUB documents into an engaging progression path with XP rewards, streaks, audio synthesis, and interactive comprehension quizzes.

## Key Features
- **Gamified Path Engine**: Winding progression tree mapping chapters into focus milestones with XP rewards.
- **Deep Focus Reader**: Typography optimized with OpenDyslexic support, distraction shields, bionic reading toggles, and ambient focus soundscapes.
- **AI Study Assistant & Smart Diagramming**: Automatic chapter summarization, concept flashcards, interactive quizzes, and visual diagram generators powered by Gemini.
- **Classroom Mission Control**: Teacher dashboards to assign EPUB readings, track student reading velocity, and inspect comprehension analytics.
- **Offline & Privacy First**: Client-side IndexedDB storage for local EPUB parsing, progress bookmarks, and offline reading.

## Links
- [Reading Path](https://readable.app/path): Main progression tree
- [Focus Reader](https://readable.app/reader): Distraction-free reading environment
- [Comprehension Quiz](https://readable.app/quiz): Interactive AI-generated quizzes
- [Trophy Room](https://readable.app/trophy-room): User level, streaks, badges, and read books library
- [Focus Lab](https://readable.app/focus-lab): Audio soundscapes and voice synthesis engine
